paper.abstract_en: In this work, we derive an exact static, axially symmetric, nonrotating vacuum solution of the Einstein field equations depending on three constant parameters: the throat radius $r_0$, a parameter $q$, which is closely associated with the Komar mass, and a parameter $s$, which determines the axial/polar structure of the geometry. For $s = 0$, the asymptotically flat wormhole sector appears, and the solution reduces to the Gibbons-Volkov ring-wormhole geometry, while the ring conical excess of the extended geometry is removed from the final physical manifold by the cut-and-paste construction. For $s \neq 0$, the solution exhibits a stronger axial singularity instead of a finite axial conical defect.
